name: Daily ZCTA-Level Sparse Stratified Counts
description: Sparse daily ZCTA-level MBSF denominator beneficiary and death counts by demographic and coverage strata. Only observed ZCTA-date-stratum combinations are included.

content.race_rti: VARCHAR: RTI race and ethnicity classification
content.n_bene__total: BIGINT: Number of beneficiaries in the total population
content.n_bene__65plus: DOUBLE: Number of beneficiaries age 65 or older
content.n_bene__ffs65plus: DOUBLE: Number of Fee-for-Service beneficiaries age 65 or older
content.n_death__total: BIGINT: Number of deaths in the total population
content.n_death__ffs: DOUBLE: Number of deaths among Fee-for-Service beneficiaries
content.n_death__65plus: DOUBLE: Number of deaths among beneficiaries age 65 or older
content.n_death__ffs65plus: DOUBLE: Number of deaths among Fee-for-Service beneficiaries age 65 or older
content.n_death__disabled: DOUBLE: Number of deaths among disabled beneficiaries
